notes.title: Small Update Coming
notes.notes:
Hey All,

Firstly, I want to thank everyone for all the support for this project. Also watching everyone crap their pants playing the game is immensely rewarding.

Just wanted to mention a few updates I am going to work on in the near future (when I finally get a moment).

[olist]
[*] First one is a bit of a spoiler, so I won't mention what it is - but it has to do with the camera locking during a particular cutscene.
[*] I also noticed that after speaking to the concierge, one Youtuber didn't go back up the stairs, and actually just skipped a portion that would have explained something he was confused about later :P
[/olist]

Hope this improves the experience for everyone.

Stay tuned!
